🪔 कृति सेनन की दिवाली पार्टी में उनके रूमर्ड बॉयफ्रेंड कबीर बाहिया की एंट्री ने लाइमलाइट बटोर ली है!

कृति ने अपने मुंबई वाले घर पर फैमिली और क्लोज फ्रेंड्स के साथ दिवाली सेलिब्रेट की। सोशल मीडिया पर शेयर की गई फोटोज में कृति अपने पैरेंट्स, बहन नूपुर सेनन और जीजा स्टेबिन बेन के साथ ट्रेडिशनल लुक में दिख रही हैं।

✨ इस सेलिब्रेशन में कृति के रूमर्ड बॉयफ्रेंड कबीर बाहिया भी नजर आए, जहां दोनों ने मैचिंग वाइट और सिल्वर आउटफिट में पोज दिया। इसके अलावा करण जौहर, सोनाक्षी सिन्हा और ज़हीर इकबाल भी इस फेस्टिवल का हिस्सा बने।

कृति ने जश्न के बीच अपनी मम्मी का मेकअप करते हुए और चाट खाते हुए कुछ खास पल भी शेयर किए। बता दें कि UK के बिजनेसमैन कबीर के साथ रिश्ते की खबरों पर कृति ने पहले कहा था कि वो शादी होने तक अपनी पर्सनल लाइफ पर बात नहीं करेंगी।

ctx.title: Kriti Sanon celebrates Diwali with rumoured boyfriend Kabir Bahia and family, Karan Johar and Sonakshi Sinha join festivities
ctx.summary: Kriti Sanon shared photos from Diwali celebrations, featuring her family, rumoured boyfriend Kabir Bahia and celebrity friends.
ctx.text:
Kriti Sanon's Diwali celebrations were all about spending time with close friends and family. The actor took to social media to share glimpses of the festivities at her Mumbai home. The pictures also featured her rumoured boyfriend, Kabir Bahia , along with several celebrity friends, including filmmaker Karan Johar and actor Sonakshi Sinha.
In the pictures, Kriti is seen posing with her parents and sister, Nupur Sanon, with everyone dressed in traditional outfits. Another picture shows her posing with her brother-in-law, singer Stebin Ben, who is married to Nupur. Kriti's rumoured boyfriend, Kabir Bahia, also joined the celebrations. The two posed together with a friend, dressed in coordinated white and silver outfits.
Filmmaker Karan Johar and actor Sonakshi Sinha, along with her husband Zaheer Iqbal, were also part of the celebrations. Apart from the festive pictures, Kriti shared some candid moments from the evening. One picture showed her helping her mother with her makeup as she got ready for Diwali, while another captured her enjoying some chaat.
Kriti wished fans on Diwali and wrote in the caption, "My favvvv time of the year with some of my fav ppl Happy Diwali everyone."
During an earlier interaction with Times Now, Kriti was asked about her rumoured relationship and Kabir's noticeable presence at her sister Nupur Sanon's wedding with singer Stebin Ben in January this year. While Kriti avoided giving a direct update on her personal life, she did hint that she prefers to keep such matters private.
She said, "I would not want to talk about my personal life at least till I am married. The day I get married. I will talk about it. There are some things that are just for me and my close people and between us, I say everything.”
Kabir Bahia is a UK-based businessman and entrepreneur. He is the founder and managing director of Worldwide Aviation and Tourism Limited, a company he established in 2020 that specialises in airline representation services. He is the son of Kuljinder Bahia, who owns UK-based travel company Southall Travel.
Kriti Sanon made her acting debut with the 2014 Telugu film 1: Nenokkadine and entered Bollywood with Heropanti the same year. Over the years, she has starred in films such as Bareilly Ki Barfi, Luka Chuppi, Mimi, Bhediya and Crew. She also turned producer with the Netflix film Do Patti (2024). Kriti was most recently seen in Cocktail 2, directed by Homi Adajania, and David Dhawan's comedy Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, both released in 2026.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
